title.narrative: Peace, Territory and Development from an Ethnic Perspective

description.narrative: The project ‘Peace, Territory and Development from an Ethnic Perspective’ seeks to promote peace and sustainable development in ethnic communities by strengthening their territorial autonomy and recognising their cultural rights. This project focuses on promoting the inclusion and resilience of territories inhabited by ethnic communities, ensuring that their voices and traditions are an integral part of the development process. To achieve this objective, strategies will be implemented that include training in territorial management, support for sustainable economic initiatives and the promotion of intercultural dialogues that reinforce peaceful coexistence. In addition, work will be carried out in collaboration with local organisations and authorities to ensure that public policies recognise and respect the specific rights and needs of these communities. Through these actions, the hope is not only to improve the quality of life of ethnic communities, but also to contribute to social cohesion and stability in the region. The project aims to be a replicable model that demonstrates how inclusive development and respect for cultural diversity can be fundamental pillars for peace and sustainable progress.
